confirm.description:
The Nous Research API answered the one-token test request for {model} with an error: {error}

Add it anyway? If the model really is unavailable, the entity will fail on its first conversation. The account key stays valid either way.
confirm.title: Add the model anyway?

data_description.chat_model: Chat model from the catalog of this endpoint.
data_description.model_sort: Changing the order and submitting reorders the list above. Nothing is saved until you pick a model.
data_description.name: Name of the generated Assist agent and AI Task entity. Defaults to the model ID.

reconfigure.description:
Change the model, or the name of the Assist agent and AI Task entity it creates, for {name}.

Integration version: {version}.

Models are listed cheapest first - the free ones come first. Use the sorting field to change the order.
reconfigure.title: Reconfigure model

data_description.chat_model: Chat model from the catalog of this endpoint.
data_description.model_sort: Changing the order and submitting reorders the list above. Nothing is saved until you pick a model.
data_description.name: Name of the generated Assist agent and AI Task entity. Defaults to the model ID.

user.description:
Add a model to {name}. It gets its own Assist agent (a conversation.* entity you can pick in Assist and in pipelines), its own AI Task entity and its own cost, token and price sensors. Only the API key, the prompt and the tools are shared with the entry.

Integration version: {version}.

Models are listed cheapest first - the free ones come first. Use the sorting field to change the order.
user.title: Add model

data_description.budget_usd: Monthly budget used for the budget remaining sensor. 0 disables it.
data_description.catalog_interval: How often the model catalog and prices are refreshed.
data_description.chat_model: Model used for new conversations. Existing entities keep their model until reloaded.
data_description.cost_sensors: Create the cost and token sensors for this entry.
data_description.llm_hass_api: Expose Home Assistant entities and services to the model as tools.
data_description.max_tokens: Upper bound for the completion, thinking tokens included.
data_description.prompt: Instructions prepended to every conversation. Leave empty to use the built-in assistant prompt.
data_description.reasoning_mode: How thinking is triggered. See the README for the exact prompt.
data_description.temperature: Sampling temperature. 0.2-0.5 works well for control tasks.
